note: Corrections to the PUC sample mappings, applied on top of the v1 transcription (data/v1-controls.json). The original v1 files are not edited. Each entry replaces the v1 IDs for one control and framework.

corrections.reason: Vulnerability scanning and tracking identify and record asset vulnerabilities (ID.RA-01); PR.PS-02 and ID.IM-04 were weaker fits.
Vendor due diligence is vendor risk assessment (CC9.2); P6.4 and P6.5 concern vendor privacy commitments.
Security event monitoring is anomaly detection (CC7.2); CC4.1 and CC4.2 concern evaluating whether controls work.
Endpoint protection prevents and detects malicious software (CC6.8); CC6.1 and CC6.7 concern logical access and data transmission.
